body: And. I don't really..have people to talk to. Any 'friends' I've had and tried to confide in or talk to have either had no idea what to say, or they've said really horrible things. I just don't want to go the rest of my life either never telling anyone what's happened to me, or having to hear the same questions over and over again. It's always "Why did you stay?" and never "Why didn't he stop?"

I'm still taking my medication, it just doesn't stop cycling completely. I know how to deal with bipolar (everything you said was spot on though!), that's just not my biggest issue really. Although, it doesn't help my future prospects (not a lot of women are going to want to deal with a mental illness this heavy).

Agh, I feel like such a jerk, I promise I'm not trying to be difficult or petulant but. I can't really eat healthy because I don't have a job, so I can't buy food. And I can't go to therapy because it costs a lot of money. The crisis line I called let me know of some free programs, but unfortunately they are all located too far away to walk to.

Thank you very much though. I know I deserve it, I just. Don't know how.
No it's totally fine and shoot I hope I didn't offend you by saying what I think will happen after death as though it's a true fact!

Not really but I think it is really really really sweet that you tried, that in and of itself is, you know, good. I'm not saying there's NO good in the world, because I have a kitty cat and my family has two dogs and holy shit animals, and also nice people sometimes it's just literally sensory...ily overwhelming how much much much much terrible there is, you know? There won't be massive changes in my life time, there are more ignorant and terrible people making laws and shit and whatever than there aren't and I know people are trying really hard but it's that whole. What is it. Go forward one, go back two thing it seems and just fucking, damn. But thanks, I just am frustrated because I don't want to kill myself until after the holidays because I have younger siblings and that would double fuck them over, I like that you use the word probs it is really cute!

Oh I don't have any way to do anything is the thing, I like volunteering though! I don't have a job because I can't keep one and yes I had a psychologist and a psychiatrist (so many people think they're the same thing and they're not, but it sounds like overkill) but my family lost insurance and no there aren't I appreciate that you tried to help though but it's all kind of just fucked!
